title: How Property Tax Exemptions for Seniors Work by State
bigPicture: Most states offer lower property taxes for seniors, but each state has its own rules.
whatYouNeedToKnow: Every state sets its own age, income, and home-value limits.
You must usually live in the home as your main house to qualify.
Some states freeze your tax bill at a set amount, while others give a flat discount.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Waiting until tax day to apply. Many offices need forms months early.
Assuming you do not qualify because of income. Some programs help moderate incomes.
actionSteps: Call your county tax office or visit their website to find the senior exemption form.
Fill out the form with proof of age, income, and that the home is your main house.
